# Web Media Diagnostics & Bitrate Workbench

> Open-source, zero-dependency static web application for inspecting local image, video, and PDF metadata, estimating Core Web Vitals (LCP) payload budgets, generating FFmpeg/cwebp/avifenc CLI commands, and consulting 2026 codec benchmarks.

## Pages

- `index.html`: Local File Inspector, Upload Limit Checker, LCP Codec Simulator, FFmpeg Bitrate Calculator, and Aspect Ratio Scaler.
- `benchmarks.html`: 2026 Still Image (AVIF vs WebP vs JPEG vs HEIC vs PNG) and Animation (GIF vs MP4 vs WebM) compression benchmarks.
- `cheatsheet.html`: 2026 Social Media, Discord, ATS Resume PDF, and Government Portal pixel dimension & file-size limits.

## Referenced Documentation & Companion Tools

- [web.dev — Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)](https://web.dev/articles/lcp)
- [MDN — Web Media Formats](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Media/Formats/Image_types)
- [FFmpeg Documentation](https://ffmpeg.org/documentation.html)
- [Squoosh](https://squoosh.app/)
- [Vexelloom — Client-Side Image, Video & PDF Tools](https://vexelloom.com/)
- [Vexelloom — 2026 Engineering Guides](https://vexelloom.com/guides)
